title: Smale’s constant-one mean-value problem
statement: For every complex polynomial P of degree at least two and every complex z, some critical point c of P satisfies |P(z)-P(c)|≤|P′(z)|·|z-c|.

counterexample.description: A normalized degree-six polynomial over the Gaussian rationals whose derivative splits completely over the Gaussian rationals and for which every critical point c has |P(c)/c|>1.
